    SELECT 
        mc.pid,
        TRY_CAST(m.year AS INT) as year_int
    FROM M_Cast mc

    WHERE mc.pid IS NOT NULL AND m.year IS NOT NULL

actor_years_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        pid,
        year_int,
        LAG(year_int) OVER (PARTITION BY pid ORDER BY year_int) as prev_year
    FROM actor_years
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT 
        pid,
        year_int - prev_year as gap
    FROM actor_years_ordered
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
),
actors_with_gaps_5_plus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pid
FROM gaps
WHERE gap >= 5
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM actor_years) - (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pid) FROM actors_with_gaps_5_plus) as actors_no_gaps_5_plus
